data.name: PageDescription
data.value: How many visits a rep can make in a period: an estimate built on the published working calendar and the authored activity budget. One capacity per period.

data.name: ContractUnavailable
data.value: The cycle capacity service is unavailable.

data.name: ArchiveCycleCapacityConfirm
data.value: Archive this capacity? Nothing is deleted, and the period becomes free for a new capacity.

data.name: EstimateNoticeTitle
data.value: This is an estimate, not a quota.

data.name: EstimateNoticeBody
data.value: The figure is built on average activity times and an interim configured FTE, not on an HR establishment. Working days come from the published calendar and can change.

data.name: BudgetVisitMinutesZero
data.value: Promoted and non-promoted product time cannot both be zero.

data.name: BudgetDailySpendExceedsDay
data.value: Travelling, reporting and quiz time leave no room for visits in the working day.

data.name: EstimateSectionHint
data.value: Working days come from the platform calendar and already exclude weekends, public holidays and closures. Only your own deductions are subtracted here.

data.name: FteMovedToMonthly
data.value: FTE is now set per month, in the monthly plan below.

data.name: NoPeriodsAvailable
data.value: No cycle period is available yet. Create one first.

data.name: CalendarCountryHint
data.value: Used only to read the working calendar. It does not change the period's scope.

data.name: CalendarCountryDerivedHint
data.value: Derived from the country-scoped period, so it cannot be changed here.

data.name: CalendarCountryNotReady
data.value: No country is available yet: no country-scoped cycle period exists.

data.name: CalendarCountryIsNotScope
data.value: A working-calendar parameter, not a scope.

data.name: DailyWorkMinutesHint
data.value: Minutes in a field working day (8 h = 480).

data.name: BetweenVisitTimeMinutesHint
data.value: Buffer left between two consecutive visits. Not part of a visit's duration; the packing engine applies it between visits.

data.name: MonthlyDeductionsHint
data.value: The months come from the period's window and cannot be added or removed. Do not deduct weekends or public holidays: the working calendar has already excluded them.

data.name: MonthsPendingPeriod
data.value: Choose a cycle period first; its window decides which months appear.

data.name: FteInterimHint
data.value: An interim configured average. When HR integration arrives this will come automatically per business unit and year.

data.name: CalculationUnavailable
data.value: The estimate could not be read.

data.name: CalendarForbiddenTitle
data.value: No permission to read the working calendar

data.name: CalendarForbiddenBody
data.value: The calendar may well exist; this account lacks the platform working-calendar permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.

data.name: CalendarUnresolvedTitle
data.value: The working calendar did not answer

data.name: CalendarUnresolvedBody
data.value: No estimate is shown rather than a guessed one. Publish a working calendar for this country and year, then try again.

data.name: MaxProductsHint
data.value: 1–10. Left empty, the stored value is kept (3 on a new record).

data.name: Err_max_products_out_of_range
data.value: The number of products per visit must be between 1 and 10.

data.name: FormLiveHint
data.value: As you change the inputs, the summary on the right and the monthly table are recalculated by the server.

data.name: ReadOnlyClosedBody
data.value: The period is closed: the capacity of a closed period and the plans that use it cannot be changed.

data.name: ReadOnlyArchivedBody
data.value: This capacity is archived and cannot be changed. Create a new capacity for the period instead.

data.name: LegacyBandTitle
data.value: This capacity is calculated with the old visit-duration model.

data.name: LegacyBandBody
data.value: Fill in the typical visit (promo count, non-promo count, report minutes per visit) and save to switch to the new model. Saving with the typical visit empty keeps the old model.

data.name: LegacyBandNumberMayChange
data.value: After switching, the estimated visit number may change: the report is then charged per visit instead of per day.

data.name: PeriodLockedHint
data.value: The period cannot be changed after the capacity is created.

data.name: PeriodPickHint
data.value: Cannot be changed after creation. Closed periods and periods that already have a capacity cannot be saved.

data.name: DailyTimeHint
data.value: Minutes per day. Travel and quiz are taken from every field day; together they must stay below the working day.

data.name: VisitDurationHint
data.value: Minutes per product × products in a typical visit + report per visit. The capacity is calculated with this typical visit duration.

data.name: TypicalVisitHint
data.value: How many products a typical visit covers. Fill in both counts and the report per visit — all three together.

data.name: BufferInfo
data.value: The buffer does not change the capacity number; it is added to the route in visit planning.

data.name: ProductLimitsHint
data.value: In planning, at most this many products can be added to a visit. The typical visit cannot exceed these limits.

data.name: SummaryError
data.value: The calculation could not be loaded. Your inputs are kept.

data.name: SummaryIdle
data.value: Choose a period to see the calculation.

data.name: SummaryAllOk
data.value: No warnings. The calculation is ready to be saved.

data.name: TeamSupplyLater
data.value: The figure is per rep. Team supply (number of reps) comes in a later release.

data.name: PartialMonthTitle
data.value: The month is cut at the period boundary.

data.name: NoNumberBlocked
data.value: No number while the inputs cannot be saved — resolve the items below.

data.name: CalendarResolvedBody
data.value: The working calendar was found. Weekends and public holidays are already excluded from the working days.

data.name: CalculationUnavailableBody
data.value: The server did not answer. Reload the page; if it persists, contact your administrator.

data.name: NoNumberCalendar
data.value: No figure: the calendar did not answer.

data.name: WaterfallHint
data.value: Period total, per rep. From working days down to the minutes left for visits, divided by the visit duration.

data.name: SupplyDemandPerRepNote
data.value: Per rep: each month’s capacity against the visits planned in the period’s planning sessions. Team size is not included yet (a later release).

data.name: OverWarning
data.value: in {0} the planned visits exceed the capacity. Move visits to other months in the planning sessions or review the capacity inputs.

data.name: SupplyUnavailableCalendar
data.value: The calendar did not answer, so there is no capacity to compare: only the planned visits are shown.

data.name: UsageUnavailable
data.value: The period’s planning data could not be read, so supply and demand cannot be compared right now.

data.name: NoDemandYet
data.value: No visits have been planned for this period yet.

data.name: NoSessions
data.value: No planning session uses this period yet.

data.name: Code_typical_visit_required
data.value: Fill in the typical visit (promo count, non-promo count, report per visit): a new capacity uses the typical-visit model.

data.name: Code_typical_visit_incomplete
data.value: The typical visit is incomplete: fill in all three fields or none.

data.name: Code_typical_visit_empty
data.value: A typical visit must cover at least one product.

data.name: Code_typical_count_exceeds_max
data.value: The typical product count exceeds the products-per-visit limit.

data.name: Code_visit_minutes_zero
data.value: The visit duration is 0 minutes; enter the minutes per product.

data.name: Code_cycle_capacity_daily_spend_exceeds_day
data.value: Daily fixed tasks use up the whole working day; no time is left for visits.

data.name: Code_month_zeroed
data.value: deducted days exceed the working days, so the month counts as 0.

data.name: Code_micro_targeting_clipped
data.value: more micro-targeting days than field days; the extra days are ignored.

data.name: Code_calendar_unresolved
data.value: No working calendar is published for this country and year.

data.name: Code_calendar_forbidden
data.value: You are not allowed to read the working calendar.

data.name: Code_country_underivable
data.value: The calendar country could not be determined; choose a calendar country.

data.name: Code_cycle_capacity_months_required
data.value: The period has no months to calculate.

data.name: Code_unknown
data.value: The calculation could not be completed.

data.name: Err_typical_visit_empty
data.value: A typical visit must cover at least one product.

data.name: Err_typical_visit_incomplete
data.value: Fill in all three typical-visit fields or none.

data.name: Err_typical_count_exceeds_max
data.value: The typical product count cannot exceed the products-per-visit limit.

data.name: Err_cycle_capacity_month_fte_invalid
data.value: A month’s FTE is out of range.

data.name: Err_period_closed
data.value: The period is closed; its capacity can no longer be changed.
